item.title: Patchy frost likely Tuesday morning but record highs possible by Thursday
item.description: You might want to protect your cold sensitive plants for one more night, but soon we'll be back in the mid 80s.

item.title: Two Harris County neighborhoods receiving millions in funding for water infrastructure
item.description: Eighteen million of your tax dollars are coming back to Harris County to help with water infrastructure.

item.title: The Woodlands looks below ground with tunnel to ease vehicle, pedestrian congestion
item.description: The Woodlands is hoping its modern-day people mover proposal will win a challenge and pay for a new way for people to get around.

item.title: Dan Patrick seeks to block Camp Mystic's summer reopening pending inquiry into July 4 flood deaths
item.description: The lieutenant governor's request to delay renewing the camp's license came hours after parents who lost children in the July 4 flood sued the state for its alleged failure to enforce an evacuation plan requirement.

item.title: Over 70 people killed in attempt to capture Mexican cartel leader and violent aftermath
item.description: More than 70 people died in Mexico's attempt to capture the notorious leader of the Jalisco New Generation Cartel and the violent aftermath of his death.

item.title: Firefighters working with Harris Co. Flood Control to put out 175-acre wildfire in NE Houston: HFD
item.description: HFD officials said they are working with the Harris County Flood Control District to put out a fire that spans roughly 175 acres, adding that 75% of the fire is contained.

item.title: Fort Bend County deputy dies after hit-and-run while helping stranded driver on I-10, officials say
item.description: Officials said that Deputy Kenneth Lewis was hit while helping a stranded driver on I-10 in west Houston. He later died in the hospital from his injuries, according to FBCSO.

item.title: 84-year-old seeking job to repay $8K in SNAP benefits as state admits error
item.description: An 84-year-old Houston woman must repay nearly $9,000 for food stamps she received during a three-and-a-half year period after the state says it made an error.

item.title: US women's gold medal-winning team declines invitation from Trump to attend State of Union address
item.description: The U.S. women's hockey gold medal-winning team has politely declined an invitation from President Donald Trump to attend his State of the Union address on Tuesday.

item.title: Aisha Dee reveals all about her Hulu series 'Watching You'
item.description: "It affects you in a way that's really unexpected." Aisha Dee unpacks the drama in "Watching You." The psychological thriller is streaming now on Hulu and Hulu on Disney+.
